jobs.occupation: Microsoft D365 Business Central: Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Business Central professional who thrives on transforming businesses through innovative technology solutions? If working in a dynamic international company sounds like your ideal next challenge, then this opportunity is made for you!

We are currently looking for a skilled and motivated colleague to join our Professional Services Department as a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Consultant.

Your Responsibilities

• 
Manage and build strong relationships with our customers, acting as a trusted advisor throughout their journey

• 
Lead and contribute to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and TravelOperations implementation projects for customers across the globe

• 
Take ownership of and drive various workstreams during those implementation projects, ensuring successful delivery and customer satisfaction

• 
Provide ongoing support, consultancy, and continuous improvement recommendations to customers after Go Live, helping them maximize the value of their solutions

• 
Collaborate with our Product Department by sharing customer insights, feedback, and functional expertise to support the continued development of our solutions

Desired Skills & Requirements

Different profiles can be relevant, but the ideal candidate has the following competencies:

• 
Solid hands-on functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, with the ability to confidently advise customers and translate business requirements into effective solutions

• 
Experience participating in or leading Business Central/NAV implementation projects, preferably in an international environment

• 
Experience within the travel industry is an advantage but not a requirement

• 
Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of your responsibilities

• 
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

• 
Enjoys working in an international environment and is open to occasional travel as part of the role

What awaits you?

• 
Enjoy real influence in a fast-growing company where execution, growth, and efficiency are core values

• 
Join a leading Microsoft technology company helping global travel businesses transform and scale

• 
Be part of an international organization with colleagues across Europe, North America, Asia, and Australia

• 
Contribute to delivering innovative Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and TravelOperations solutions to travel companies worldwide, combining industry expertise with modern technology

• 
Benefit from a flexible working environment

• 
Join a strong, collaborative culture where people enjoy working together and building something meaningful

The role is based at one of our offices in Copenhagen, Aalborg, Halmstad, or Brisbane (Australia).

How to Apply

For more details, please contact, HR Manager, Nicholas Poulsen, at nop@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

We can't wait to hear from you!

About Travel Operations A/S

At TravelOperations, we're not just about professionalism and ambition; we're about building an environment where every employee shines. Our global reach spans from Greenland to Australia, as we partner with leading travel agencies, airlines, and leisure-focused businesses to craft tailor-made solutions. Join us in reshaping the travel industry landscape, where responsiveness and innovation are our guiding stars.

Diversity and Inclusion

At our company, Diversity and Inclusion are core values. We welcome applicants of all genders, striving for a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. Join us in building an inclusive future where diversity is celebrated as a strength.

jobs.occupation: Grow365.io is Hiring an Ambitious Account Manager for the UK Market
jobs.description:
Join Grow365.io on an exciting digital growth journey

Grow365.io is a fast-growing software company helping B2B businesses generate new customers and enter new markets through AI and automation software.

We already work with companies such as Jyllands-Posten, Kingspan, JKS and many others. We are now looking for an ambitious Account Manager to help strengthen our presence in the UK market.

You will become part of a young, energetic team based in Aarhus, Denmark, where sales, advisory and high performance go hand in hand.

About the role

As Account Manager, you will be responsible for the full sales process in the UK market – from the first contact to closing the deal.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn and Grow365.io

• 
Booking and conducting online meetings with potential customers

• 
Understanding customer needs and advising them on relevant solutions

• 
Following up with prospects and closing deals

• 
Building and maintaining strong customer relationships

• 
Working closely with management and the sales team

What we offer

At Grow365.io, you will have the opportunity to build a strong international sales career in a company with high ambitions and significant growth potential.

We offer:

• 
Competitive base salary combined with an attractive commission scheme

• 
Uncapped earning potential

• 
Strong professional and personal development opportunities

• 
Thorough onboarding and training

• 
Professional equipment

• 
An ambitious and supportive working environment

• 
A varied role in a fast-growing software company

• 
Regular social and professional events

Who are you?

We are looking for someone with energy, drive and a strong desire to achieve results. You enjoy speaking with customers, building relationships and working towards clear targets.

We particularly value that you:

• 
Are confident and persuasive on the phone

• 
Can build trust quickly with potential customers

• 
Work independently and in a structured way

• 
Are comfortable making a high volume of calls

• 
Are motivated by targets, results and performance

• 
Take responsibility and follow through on your tasks

• 
Speak and write English fluently

Previous sales experience is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important thing is your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn and develop.

Practical information

The position is based in Aarhus, Denmark, and focuses on the UK market.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact CEO Mads Thomsen on +45 50 42 04 78.

Please send your application to mads@grow365.io.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description: EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.The RoleAs Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.Your responsibilities will include:    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.    Working in close cooperations with order management team     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.Is this you?To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.Do you want to know more?I In this process EYKON is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Stina Koskijev at +46735588921, or stina.koskijev@levelrecruitment.se. Please note, no applications are allowed on email. Please highlight your key skills and industry experience.We will interview ongoingly so please register your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Ingénieur-e de recherche en acoustique F/H (H/F)
jobs.description: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous?Le poste est rattaché au chef du groupe Acoustique au sein du département Physique. Vous contribuerez au renouvellement nécessaire des solutions acoustiques de Saint-Gobain pour mieux répondre aux défis du changement climatique.Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes:Contribuer à la recherche et à la conception de nouveaux matériaux, produits et systèmes avec des performances acoustiques optimisées, pour les domaines de la construction et de l'industrie des transports.Evaluer les performances acoustiques des solutions in situ dans l'habitat en lien (par l'expérience et la simulation) avec le confort acoustique ressenti.Développer la veille technologique (publications, brevets, normalisation) et la mise en place de partenariats aussi bien avec le milieu industriel qu'avec les laboratoires académiques.***Reporting to the Acoustics Group Leader within the Physics Department, you will contribute to the development and renewal of Saint-Gobain's acoustic solutions to better address the challenges posed by climate change.Your key responsibilities will include:Contribute to the research and design of new materials, products, and systems with optimized acoustic performance for the construction and transport sectors.Evaluate the in-situ acoustic performance of solutions in residential settings, correlating findings (via testing and simulation) with perceived acoustic comfort.Conduct technology monitoring (publications, patents, standardization) and establish partnerships with both industry and academic laboratories.Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, créative et motivée par l'innovation, qui sait présenter ses résultats de manière pédagogique et qui apprécie la résolution de problèmes et le travail collaboratif.Doctorat en acoustique.Poste ouvert à une sortie de thèse ; première expérience après la thèse possible.Expertise en acoustique dans les domaines des matériaux, du génie civil et de l'habitat, avec un vif intérêt pour les travaux expérimentaux et la modélisation numérique (éléments finis).Maîtrise de l'anglais indispensable***We are looking above all for someone who is curious, rigorous, creative and driven by innovation, with the ability to present results in a clear and accessible manner and who enjoys problem-solving and collaborative work.PhD in Acoustics.Position open to recent PhD graduates; previous postdoctoral professional experience is also welcome.Expertise in acoustics applied to materials, civil engineering and building applications, with a strong interest in experimental work and numerical modelling (finite element methods).Fluency in English is essential.
